section.content: 本申请提供一种锂离子电池。所述锂离子电池包括第一正负极电极对。所述第一正负极电极对包括正极片、负极片、第一隔膜、第二隔膜和柔性电路板。所述柔性电路板上集成有检测电路，用于检测所述第一正负极电极对内的温度和电位。所述第一隔膜和所述第二隔膜设置于所述正极片与所述负极片之间。所述柔性电路板设置于所述第一隔膜和所述第二隔膜之间。在所述锂离子电池叠片或卷绕过程中设置所述柔性电路板，由于所述检测电路集成在所述柔性电路板上，在测量过程中不需要导线连接，因此解决了过多的导线导致的锂离子电池不易封装的问题。此外，所述柔性电路板在所述第一正负极电极对内部容易固定，有效解决了测量点因尺寸较小不易固定的问题。

The application provides a kind of lithium ion battery.The lithium ion battery includes the first positive and negative anodes electrode pair.The first positive and negative anodes electrode is to including positive plate, negative electrode tab, the first diaphragm, the second diaphragm and flexible circuit board.It is integrated with detection circuit on the flexible circuit board, for detecting the first positive and negative anodes electrode internal temperature and current potential.First diaphragm and second diaphragm are set between the positive plate and the negative electrode tab.The flexible circuit board is set between first diaphragm and second diaphragm.The flexible circuit board is set in the lithium ion battery lamination or winding process, since the detection circuit is integrated on the flexible circuit board, conducting wire connection is not needed in measurement process, therefore solves the problems, such as that lithium ion battery caused by excessive conducting wire is not easy to encapsulate.In addition, the flexible circuit board easily fixes inside in the first positive and negative anodes electrode, solve the problems, such as that measurement point is not fixed easily because size is smaller.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

This application involves power source technical fields, more particularly to a kind of lithium ion battery.

Background technique

With the promotion of energy density, volume also becoming larger power battery, and the inhomogeneities of internal-response is to battery The influence of performance is increasing.At the same time, the research of lithium ion battery coupled thermomechanics becomes the concern of battery performance and safety Hot spot.Wherein, the measurement of the inner parameter in battery use process is the key that establish coupled thermomechanics model.

Lithium ion battery has airtightness, and it is very difficult to obtain the distributed intelligence of inside battery physical quantity.Traditional scheme be Inside battery arranges microsensor, and existing sensor power supply and data transmission need to access lead, this just gives lithium ion battery Packaging belt come it is difficult.

Utility model content
